name: Milk, full-cream / full-fat
storage: Keep in the fridge at 4 °C or below and use within a day or two; do not leave it out for long. Boil once, cool and refrigerate if keeping.
looksLike: White, creamy liquid in a sealed pouch or carton; sold as full cream (for example Amul Gold, Mother Dairy full cream, Gokul full cream), richer than toned or double-toned milk.
howToPick: Check the pack for 'full cream' (FSSAI minimum 6.0% fat, 9.0% SNF) and the expiry date; choose a cold, undamaged, sealed pouch.
shelfLife: Pasteurised pouch milk keeps about 1 to 2 days in the fridge after purchase or until the printed date; boil before use if it is plain pasteurised (general guidance).
substitutes: Full-fat milk plus a little cream or khoya
